# Library of Congress

> The Library of Congress is the United States' oldest federal cultural institution, the research arm of Congress, and the world's largest library.

The Library of Congress provides access to vast physical and digital collections spanning books, manuscripts, photographs, maps, films, sound recordings, legal materials, and more. Its website supports discovery, research, education, public programs, visitor services, and specialized institutions including the U.S. Copyright Office, Congress.gov, and the Law Library of Congress.

## Main Entry Points
- [Home](https://www.loc.gov/): Main portal to Library of Congress collections, services, news, and featured programs.
- [Discover](https://www.loc.gov/discover/): Browse major collection areas, digital resources, and thematic discovery paths.
- [Services and Programs](https://www.loc.gov/services-and-programs/): Overview of research, preservation, standards, and public-facing Library services.
- [Visit](https://www.loc.gov/visit/): Visitor information for buildings, exhibitions, events, tours, and reading rooms.
- [Education](https://www.loc.gov/education/): Teaching resources, primary sources, and classroom materials for educators and students.
- [Connect](https://www.loc.gov/connect/): Access blogs, social media, podcasts, and other public engagement channels.
- [About](https://www.loc.gov/about/): Institutional information, leadership, history, and organizational structure.
- [Help](https://www.loc.gov/help/): Help resources for searching, using collections, accessibility, and site support.

## Search, Catalogs, and Discovery Tools
- [Search the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/search/): Sitewide search across collections, webpages, and digital materials.
- [Digital Collections](https://www.loc.gov/collections/): Browse curated digital collections by topic, format, and repository.
- [Online Catalog](https://catalog.loc.gov/): Search bibliographic records for books, serials, maps, recordings, and other holdings.
- [Prints and Photographs Online Catalog](https://www.loc.gov/pictures/): Search digitized images and catalog records from visual collections.
- [Chronicling America](https://chroniclingamerica.loc.gov/): Search historic American newspapers and U.S. newspaper directory records.
- [American Memory](https://memory.loc.gov/ammem/index.html): Legacy gateway to digitized historical collections and primary sources.
- [Finding Aids](https://findingaids.loc.gov/): Search archival finding aids for manuscripts and special collections.
- [Research Guides](https://guides.loc.gov/): Subject guides created by librarians for collections and research topics.

## Research and Reference
- [Ask a Librarian](https://ask.loc.gov/): Submit research questions and access reference services by subject or format.
- [Research Centers](https://www.loc.gov/research-centers/): Explore reading rooms and specialized research centers across disciplines.
- [Using the Library](https://www.loc.gov/research-centers/use-the-library/): Learn how to register, request materials, and work in reading rooms.
- [Researchers](https://www.loc.gov/researchers/): Starting point for onsite and remote researchers using Library resources.
- [Reference and Research Services](https://www.loc.gov/rr/): Access subject specialists, reading rooms, and reference resources.
- [Library of Congress Subject Headings](https://www.loc.gov/aba/cataloging/subject/): Authoritative subject vocabulary used in library cataloging and discovery.
- [Authorities and Vocabularies](https://id.loc.gov/): Linked data services for names, subjects, classifications, and standards.

## Collections and Special Divisions
- [American Folklife Center](https://www.loc.gov/folklife/): Documentation and research resources for folklife, ethnography, and oral history.
- [Geography and Map Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/geogmap/): Maps, atlases, cartographic collections, and geography research services.
- [Manuscript Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/mss/): Manuscripts, personal papers, and archival collections for historical research.
- [Music Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/perform/): Music, theater, dance, and performing arts collections and services.
- [Prints and Photographs Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/print/): Photographs, posters, drawings, and visual materials research resources.
- [Rare Book and Special Collections Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/rb/): Rare books, early printing, and special collections access information.
- [Motion Picture, Broadcasting and Recorded Sound Division](https://www.loc.gov/rr/mopic/): Film, television, radio, and recorded sound collections and research support.
- [Veterans History Project](https://www.loc.gov/vets/): Oral histories and materials documenting U.S. veterans' experiences.

## Education and Learning
- [Education](https://www.loc.gov/education/): Central hub for K–12 teaching materials and primary source resources.
- [Teachers](https://www.loc.gov/programs/teachers/): Teacher programs, professional development, and classroom-ready primary source sets.
- [Students](https://www.loc.gov/programs/teachers/getting-started-with-primary-sources/): Introductory materials for learning with primary sources in classrooms.
- [Primary Source Sets](https://www.loc.gov/programs/teachers/classroom-materials/primary-source-sets/): Curated sets of primary sources organized for classroom use.
- [Classroom Materials](https://www.loc.gov/programs/teachers/classroom-materials/): Lesson plans, activities, and analysis tools for educators.
- [Read.gov](https://read.gov/): Reading promotion site with classic texts, literacy resources, and family activities.
- [National Book Festival](https://www.loc.gov/bookfest/): Annual festival featuring authors, books, talks, and reading-related programming.

## Visit, Events, and Public Programs
- [Visit the Library](https://www.loc.gov/visit/): Plan a visit to Library buildings, exhibitions, and public spaces.
- [Events](https://www.loc.gov/events/): Calendar of lectures, concerts, festivals, and public programs.
- [Exhibitions](https://www.loc.gov/exhibits/): Current and past exhibitions featuring treasures from Library collections.
- [Concerts](https://www.loc.gov/concerts/): Performance schedule and information for the Library's concert series.
- [Thomas Jefferson Building](https://www.loc.gov/visit/places/jefferson-building/): Visitor details for the Library's historic main building on Capitol Hill.
- [James Madison Memorial Building](https://www.loc.gov/visit/places/madison-building/): Visitor information for reading rooms, programs, and services in Madison Building.
- [John Adams Building](https://www.loc.gov/visit/places/adams-building/): Visitor information for the Adams Building and its research spaces.
- [Packard Campus for Audio Visual Conservation](https://www.loc.gov/programs/national-audio-visual-conservation-center/packard-campus-theater/): Public screenings and programs at the Packard Campus theater.

## Services, Standards, and Preservation
- [Services and Programs](https://www.loc.gov/services-and-programs/): Entry point for Library services, standards, and institutional programs.
- [Cataloging Distribution Service](https://www.loc.gov/cds/): Cataloging products, metadata services, and bibliographic tools.
- [Preservation](https://www.loc.gov/preservation/): Preservation science, conservation, and stewardship of collections.
- [Digital Preservation](https://www.loc.gov/programs/digital-preservation/): Programs, resources, and guidance for preserving digital content.
- [Copyright Office](https://copyright.gov/): U.S. Copyright Office registration, policy, records, and guidance.
- [National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled](https://www.loc.gov/nls/): Accessible library services for people with temporary or permanent print disabilities.
- [Standards](https://www.loc.gov/standards/): Library and information standards maintained or supported by the Library.
- [MARC Standards](https://www.loc.gov/marc/): Documentation and specifications for MARC bibliographic and authority formats.

## Law, Congress, and Government Information
- [Congress.gov](https://www.congress.gov/): Federal legislative information including bills, resolutions, members, and committee activity.
- [Law Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/law/): Legal research resources, foreign and comparative law, and public services.
- [Legal Research Institute](https://www.loc.gov/law/find/): Guides and tools for conducting legal research using Library resources.
- [Global Legal Monitor](https://www.loc.gov/item/global-legal-monitor/): Reports on legal developments from jurisdictions around the world.
- [THOMAS Archive and Legislative Resources](https://www.loc.gov/collections/united-states-congress-web-archive/): Archived congressional web resources and related legislative materials.
- [U.S. Constitution Annotated](https://constitution.congress.gov/): Constitutional analysis and interpretation prepared for Congress.

## News, Blogs, and Media
- [News from the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/news/): Press releases, announcements, and institutional news updates.
- [Blogs](https://blogs.loc.gov/): Official Library blogs covering collections, research, and public programs.
- [The Signal](https://blogs.loc.gov/thesignal/): Blog focused on digital preservation and digital collections stewardship.
- [In Custodia Legis](https://blogs.loc.gov/law/): Law Library blog on legal history, collections, and research.
- [Picture This](https://blogs.loc.gov/picturethis/): Prints and Photographs Division blog featuring visual collections highlights.
- [Folklife Today](https://blogs.loc.gov/folklife/): American Folklife Center blog on traditions, fieldwork, and cultural heritage.
- [Library of Congress Magazine](https://www.loc.gov/lcm/): Magazine featuring stories about collections, people, and programs.
- [Podcasts](https://www.loc.gov/podcasts/): Audio programs exploring Library collections, history, and cultural topics.

## Help, Contact, and Support
- [Help](https://www.loc.gov/help/): General help for using the website, collections, and Library services.
- [Contact](https://www.loc.gov/contact/): Contact information for departments, services, and general inquiries.
- [Ask a Librarian](https://ask.loc.gov/): Direct reference assistance from Library specialists and reading rooms.
- [Accessibility](https://www.loc.gov/accessibility/): Accessibility information for the website, buildings, and services.
- [Support the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/programs/support-the-library-of-congress/about-this-program/): Information on donations and philanthropic support opportunities.
- [Shop](https://library-of-congress-shop.myshopify.com/): Official store for books, gifts, and Library-themed merchandise.
